summary: Busy apartment street where cars park, homes 17-35 m away on both sides.

best_section.where: Mid-street on Depper Street, opposite the garages and the vacant plot

drivers.seclusion: Garages 17 m on the far side, apartments (Sevilla 35 m, others 18 m) beyond; dwellings within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parked-car lane along this kerb, room for a van among other cars.
drivers.traffic: Residential side street linking two roads, moderate local traffic.
drivers.convention: Many cars park here, but 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Slope about 2.7% mean, steeper in places up to 15% max
sun_shade: Open sky over the section; street trees give patchy shade from the south.
